arxiv-1803-06267.title: Consistent sets of lines with no colorful incidence
arxiv-1803-06267.creator: Boris Bukh, Xavier Goaoc, Alfredo Hubard, Matthew Trager
arxiv-1803-06267.description: Abstract We consider incidences among colored sets of lines in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} and examine whether the existence of certain concurrences between lines of k k colors force the existence of at least one concurrence between lines of k + 1 k+1 colors. This question is relevant for problems in 3D reconstruction in computer vision.

arxiv-2002-03116.title: Momentum selective optical absorption in triptycene molecular membrane
arxiv-2002-03116.creator: Masashi Akita 1 , Yasumaru Fujii 2 , Mina Maruyama 2 , Susumu Okada 2 and Katsunori Wakabayashi 1,3,4
arxiv-2002-03116.description: Abstract The optical properties of triptycene molecular membranes (TMMs) under the linearly and circularly polarized light irradiation have been theoretically studied. Since TMMs have the double-layered Kagome lattice structures for their π \pi -electrons, i.e., tiling of trigonal and hexagonal-symmetric rings, the electronic band structures of TMMs have non-equivalent Dirac cones and perfect flat bands.

arxiv-2104-03098.title: Orbifold construction and Lorentzian construction of Leech lattice vertex operator algebra
arxiv-2104-03098.creator: Naoki Chigira (1) , Ching Hung Lam (2) and Masahiko Miyamoto (3) ( 1 ) (1) Department of Mathematics, Kumamoto University ( 2 ) , ( 3 ) (2),(3) Institute of Mathematics, Academia Sinica ( 3 ) (3) Institute of Mathematics, University of Tsukuba
arxiv-2104-03098.description: Abstract We generalize Conway-Sloane’s constructions of the Leech lattice from Niemeier lattices using Lorentzian lattice to holomorphic vertex operator algebras (VOA) of central charge 24 24 . It provides a tool for analyzing the structures and relations among holomorphic VOAs related by orbifold construction.

arxiv-2210-01540.title: Inclusion of Frequency Nadir constraint in the Unit Commitment Problem of Small Power Systems Using Machine Learning
arxiv-2210-01540.creator: Mohammad Rajabdorri, Behzad Kazemtabrizi, Matthias Troffaes, Lukas Sigrist, Enrique Lobato
arxiv-2210-01540.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Rajabdorri, Behzad Kazemtabrizi, Matthias Troffaes, Lukas Sigrist, Enrique Lobato. As the intention is to reduce the amount of thermal generation and to increase the share of clean energy, power systems are increasingly becoming susceptible to frequency instability after outages due to reduced levels of inertia. To address this issue frequency constraints are being included in the scheduling process, which ensure a tolerable frequency deviation in case of any contingencies.

arxiv-2301-09183.title: Entanglement and maximal violation of the CHSH inequality in a system of two spins j j : a novel construction and further observations
arxiv-2301-09183.creator: G. Peruzzo, S. P. Sorella
arxiv-2301-09183.description: Abstract We study the CHSH inequality for a system of two spin j j particles, for generic j j . The CHSH operator is constructed using a set of unitary, Hermitian operators { A 1 , A 2 , B 1 , B 2 } \left\{A_{1},A_{2},B_{1},B_{2}\right\} .

arxiv-2305-15708.title: Score-Based Multimodal Autoencoder
arxiv-2305-15708.creator: Daniel Wesego dweseg2@uic.edu, Pedram Rooshenas pedram@uic.edu
arxiv-2305-15708.description: Abstract Multimodal Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) represent a promising group of generative models that facilitate the construction of a tractable posterior within the latent space given multiple modalities. Previous studies have shown that as the number of modalities increases, the generative quality of each modality declines.

arxiv-2401-03465.title: Degeneration of families of projective hypersurfaces and Hodge conjecture
arxiv-2401-03465.creator: Johann Bouali
arxiv-2401-03465.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Johann Bouali. We prove by induction on dimension the Hodge conjecture for smooth complex projective varieties. Let X X be a smooth complex projective variety. arxiv-2506-06231.title: Towards an Explainable Comparison and Alignment of Feature Embeddings
arxiv-2506-06231.creator: Mohammad Jalali, Bahar Dibaei Nia, Farzan Farnia
arxiv-2506-06231.description: Abstract While several feature embedding models have been developed in the literature, comparisons of these embeddings have largely focused on their numerical performance in classification-related downstream applications. However, an interpretable comparison of different embeddings requires identifying and analyzing mismatches between sample groups clustered within the embedding spaces.

pmc-10660731.title: Baccharis Species Essential Oils: Repellency and Toxicity against Yellow Fever Mosquitoes and Imported Fire Ants
pmc-10660731.creator: Abbas Ali, Farhan Mahmood Shah, Jane Manfron, Luciane M. Monteiro, Valter P. de Almeida, Vijayasankar Raman, Ikhlas A. Khan
pmc-10660731.description: Essential oils from five Baccharis species were screened for their toxicity and biting deterrence/repellency against yellow fever mosquito, Aedes aegypti (L.), and imported fire ants, including Solenopsis invicta Buren (RIFA), Solenopsis richteri Forel (BIFA) and their hybrids (HIFA). Baccharis microdonta DC. and B. punctulata DC.

pmc-11583552.title: Clinical significance and expression of SLC35F6 in bladder urothelial carcinoma
pmc-11583552.creator: Jinling Zhang, Siqi Liu, Meng Wu, Wenyu Shi, Yihong Cai
pmc-11583552.description: BackgroundSLC35F6 negatively regulates outer mitochondrial membrane permeability and positively regulates apoptotic signaling pathways and cell population proliferation. The biological function of SLC35F6 in bladder cancer (BC) remains inadequately established. This study evaluates the expression and clinical significance of SLC35F6 in BC, assesses its prognostic value and explores its relationship with key immune-related molecules in the tumor microenvironment.

pmc-11650782.title: Assessing the swelling behavior of oil paint in fatty acid methyl esters (FAMEs)†
pmc-11650782.creator: Chiara Biribicchi, Michael Doutre, Gabriele Favero
pmc-11650782.description: Fatty Acid Methyl Esters (FAMEs) have gained attention as low-impact solvents, offering low toxicity and versatility in applications ranging from biofuels to chemical feedstocks. This study investigates the swelling behavior of naturally-aged zinc white oil paint fragments when exposed to FAMEs with varying chain lengths.

pmc-11716875.title: Extended Exposure to Alzheimer's Risk Factors Increases Alzheimer's Diagnosis Risk Amplified in APOε4 Carriers: Implication for Delayed Onset of Alzheimer's Risk Factors
pmc-11716875.creator: Simona Merlini, Francesca Vitali, Roberta Diaz Brinton
pmc-11716875.description: BackgroundObesity, diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and depression are relevant Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) modifiable risk factors (RFs). However, little is known about how the duration of these conditions, influenced by unmodifiable AD risk factors, such as chromosomal sex and APOE genotype, affects the associated risk.

pmc-12579994.title: Predictors of short-term outcomes after postoperative periprosthetic femoral fracture
pmc-12579994.creator: Mohammad Aryaie, Jonathan T. Evans, Cliff L. Shelton, Antony Johansen, Toby O. Smith, Michael R. Whitehouse, Dawn Goodwin, Alex Bottle, on behalf of the PROFOUND study team
pmc-12579994.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AimsPostoperative periprosthetic femoral fractures (POPFFs) following hip and knee arthroplasty are increasing. They often have poor outcomes. We have limited understanding of the predictors of these outcomes, which this study addresses.MethodsWe extracted administrative hospital data for patients aged 18 years and above with admissions to NHS hospitals in England with a primary diagnosis of POPFF between April 2016 and December 2022, including demographic characteristics, comorbidities, surgery for POPFF, admission source, outpatient department (OPD) appointments, and pre-POPFF admissions.

pmc-12743009.title: Cubital Tunnel Release Under Local and Regional Anesthesia: A Scoping Review
pmc-12743009.creator: Madeline E Hubbard, Amr AlMasri, Nasimul S Huq
pmc-12743009.description: Introduction: Cubital tunnel syndrome (CuTS) occurs due to compression or traction of the ulnar nerve at the elbow. When conservative management fails, CuTS release (including decompression and transposition) can be performed. Recently, more research has investigated local anesthesia (LA) and regional anesthesia (RA) for CuTS release.

pmc-12754892.title: A systematic review of educational interventions to enhance ethical sensitivity in nursing students in Asia and the Middle East
pmc-12754892.creator: Xiaopu Shi, Rui Wang, Ying Li, Lili Zeng
pmc-12754892.description: BackgroundAs future providers of medical services, nursing students require strong ethical sensitivity to effectively manage clinical ethical dilemmas. However, studies have shown that they often exhibit lower ethical sensitivity than practicing nurses, which may hinder their ability to address ethical challenges competently.

pmc-13067182.title: Molecular classification and construction of prognostic risk model via machine learning based on metabolic-related genes in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13067182.creator: Hongkang Wang, Yonghao Li, Huayu Zhang, Yaozhong Ping, Wan Zhang, Ying’ao Chen, Bing Han
pmc-13067182.description: BackgroundDespite recent advances in therapeutic strategies for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), patient prognosis remains unsatisfactory. Accumulating evidence indicated that dysregulation of metabolism-related pathways and genes plays a pivotal role in HCC progression. Accordingly, metabolic-associated genes hold promise as prognostic biomarkers and potential predictors of therapeutic response.

pmc-13687151.title: Estimating the Share of Social Surplus Generated by Pharmaceutical Innovation Accruing to Manufacturers: A Systematic Literature Review
pmc-13687151.creator: Robert J. Nordyke, Tyler D. Wagner, Janine Ross, Sreeranjani Menon, Jonathan D. Campbell
pmc-13687151.description: IntroductionPharmaceutical innovation operates within an implicit social contract that seeks to balance incentives for future drug development with equitable access to current therapies. A key metric for evaluating this balance is producer surplus (PS), which represents the share of total social surplus (the sum of consumer surplus [CS] and PS) captured by manufacturers.
